name: Empty Sampling Tube
summary: In Auberdine, Thundris Windweaver gives you an Empty Sampling Tube to test the Cliffspring River. Night elf scholars study the taint threatening Darkshore.

sections.title: Testing the Waters
sections.body: Darkshore's waterways are turning foul as blight spreads through the wilderness. In Auberdine, Thundris Windweaver investigates the change. He gives you an empty glass tube for water from the Cliffspring River. Take the sample from the pool beneath the first waterfall north of town. Night elf naturalists will examine it to learn about the corruption flowing toward Mist's Edge.

sections.title: Tracing the Source
sections.body: Blackwood furbolgs live in camps along the riverbanks. Windweaver suspects they suffer from the rot and spread it, rather than cause it. The sample confirms that contamination flows from Felwood's tainted heights to the east. It may help shape a cure and guide a direct response to the blight.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Empty Sampling Tube?
aliases: why do i have this tube
what does the sampling tube do
faq.answer: Use the Empty Sampling Tube to collect water from the corrupted Cliffspring River north of Auberdine. Bring the sample to Thundris Windweaver, who studies the foul substances spreading through Darkshore.

faq.q: Where is the water sample supposed to be taken?
faq.answer: Fill the tube at the first waterfall on the Cliffspring River, north of Auberdine. The pool lies beneath an overhead bridge, before the water spills into Mist's Edge.
Thundris Windweaver gives you the tube. He is a night elf naturalist studying threats to the land around Auberdine.

faq.q: What is polluting the Cliffspring River?
faq.answer: Blackwood furbolgs live along the riverbanks and add to the filth. Yet the taint flows from Felwood's corrupted woodland, high in the mountains to the east.

angles.text: As a druid, you can help uncover how Felwood's taint reaches Darkshore's rivers and sickens local wildlife.
As a night elf of Auberdine, you can help test the Cliffspring River and keep its corrupting runoff from poisoning your coastal haven at Mist's Edge.
